Our Manufacturing & Brands

In addition, our enterprise serves our people by producing high-quality auto air filters, cabin filters, and oil filters right here in our country, effectively replacing imported goods. Over the years, we have pleased our buyers with a variety of products offered under trademarks such as "ARASSA", "TÄMIZ", and "FLOW". The establishment of our own manufacturing plant was an important milestone, allowing us to ensure reasonable prices and stability.

Learn More

Global Import Partners

The goods offered at our sales points are high-quality products sourced from developed countries such as the Republic of Turkey, the Russian Federation, the People's Republic of China, Japan, South Korea, and Thailand.

Infrastructure & Warehouse

Our goods, encompassing more than 20,000 types of spare parts for passenger cars, are offered to customers in both wholesale and retail across 5 regions of our country.

Gallery

Photos of our enterprise, manufacturing facilities, and products.

Our points of sale

We offer our products wholesale and retail in 5 regions of our country. Find the store nearest to you.

Ready to Partner With Us?

With the continuous development of our sunny country, Belent Maksatly Doganlar will keep contributing to this growth at a rapid pace. Our doors are always open to customers who want to purchase our high-quality, reasonably priced goods.
